description: This file defines the LeaveTypeController class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It inherits from AbstractVueController and implements a preRender method that sets up a Vue component called 'leave-type-list'. The file is part of the controller layer, handling leave type views for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeaveTypeController
classes.description: Controller for managing leave types, extends AbstractVueController and manages Vue components for leave type views.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by setting up the 'leave-type-list' Vue component.
